arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Anders argued Section 145 permits district court review.
She stated applicants can seek judicial review of agency denials.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the substance of the new evidence.
She asked what content constituted new evidence beyond form.
